subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw make live provider model discovery part of the default model catalog/list/picker behavior, or keep it limited to explicit provider wildcards and provider-specific flows?
rationale: The remaining choice affects provider API contracts, config semantics, model selection UX, offline caching, endpoint trust, and safety/cost policy, which cannot be resolved safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical design thread while reviewing narrower implementation PRs against the chosen provider-catalog contract.

options.title: Split by provider
options.body: Move remaining work into provider-specific issues so OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible providers, and local providers can each land independently.

options.title: Limit to wildcards
options.body: Declare explicit `provider/*` configuration the supported dynamic-discovery surface and close broader default catalog discovery as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical design thread while reviewing narrower implementation PRs against the chosen provider-catalog contract.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 authored and is assigned to this maintainer-labeled product/design issue.
